metaDescription: CKPC Properties has secured a long-term office lease with TCS (Tata Consultancy Services) at 360° Business Park, Electronic City, Bengaluru — 1.4 million sq ft over 15 years. What this means for Heart of Harmony buyers.
h1: CKPC Properties Secures Long-Term TCS Office Lease — A Landmark for Grade A+ Commercial Real Estate in Bengaluru

blocks.text: CKPC Properties’ successful closure of a long-term lease with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) at 360° Business Park marks a defining moment. The transaction, spanning 1.4 million sq ft over a 15-year term, is among the largest office leasing deals in the country in recent years. It reflects deep trust, execution capability, and the ability to deliver future-ready workspaces. The same standards of design and execution now shape CKPC Heart of Harmony — CKPC’s flagship luxury residential project at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Main Road, Bengaluru.
Execution Capability at Scale

Delivering 1.4 million sq ft of Grade-A office space requires more than design intent — it demands robust execution. The project is being delivered in two phases across multiple floors, with timelines carefully aligned to tenant requirements. This level of planning reflects CKPC’s ability to manage complex, large-scale developments while maintaining delivery certainty.

Moreover, transactions of this magnitude involve rigorous due diligence covering structural design, regulatory compliance, infrastructure readiness, and long-term asset performance. Successfully closing and executing this deal signals CKPC’s operational reliability and project management strength.
Validation of Design and Development Philosophy

The 360° Business Park has been envisioned as more than just an office space — it is designed as a future-ready business ecosystem. It incorporates large, efficient floor plates, advanced building systems, and sustainability-focused features, including green building certifications. This aligns with a growing industry shift. Occupiers today prioritise employee well-being, ESG compliance, and flexible workspace design, and CKPC’s People Experience (PX) philosophy reinforces the same. CKPC’s ability to deliver on these expectations demonstrates a deep understanding of evolving workplace needs.
A Strong Signal of Market Confidence

Beyond the transaction itself, this lease sends a strong signal to the broader market. Bengaluru continues to lead India’s office absorption, driven by the expansion of IT services and Global Capability Centres (GCCs). Large deals like this reflect renewed confidence in long-term office demand, even in a hybrid work era. For CKPC, this milestone reinforces its credibility not just with tenants, but also with investors, partners, and stakeholders. It positions the company as a preferred developer for large, strategic occupiers seeking long-term, scalable solutions.
Reinforcing a Future-Ready Vision

At its core, this milestone reflects CKPC’s long-term vision: to create spaces that go beyond infrastructure and enable meaningful experiences. By combining scale, sustainability, and user-centric design, CKPC is not only meeting current market expectations but actively shaping the future of real estate in India — both commercial and residential.
What Does This Mean for Heart of Harmony Buyers?

For buyers evaluating Heart of Harmony, CKPC’s commercial track record with TCS provides direct context for understanding the developer’s commitment to quality, timelines, and delivery standards. The same execution discipline that earned TCS’s trust for 1.4 million sq ft over 15 years is being applied to Heart of Harmony — a RERA-registered, 24-floor luxury residential project at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Main Road, Bengaluru 560068.
